no_unqualified_state_mutation.justification: A conserved continuation owner may change only through an explicitly qualified typed transfer or transformation; absence of a process law confers no authority to delete or reroute mass.

receiver_neutral_conservation_identity.justification: For any admitted transfer, source decrement is bounded by available continuation mass and the sum of explicitly declared receiver gains must equal the transferred mass exactly.

persistence_not_physical_inertness.justification: The contract explicitly labels persistence as an epistemic fail-closed state-update rule and preserves physical-process uncertainty; it does not claim real dry NH4 is inert.

process_ordering_required.justification: Any concrete future process must declare ordering relative to hydrological state creation, additions, runoff, infiltration, adsorption, transformation and atmospheric loss because trajectory differences can arise despite mass closure.

specific_dry_phase_or_process_law.justification: SQ03 intentionally does not qualify a physical dry phase, dry chemistry, transfer rate, or atmospheric/soil exchange law.

specific_rewetting_receiver_or_kinetics.justification: SQ03 qualifies only the receiver-neutral bounded interface; receiver identity, activation, fraction and kinetics require later scientific qualification.
